name: debug-save-ui-refused
description: The page opens the debug view and starts a save of the logs folder; a second save while the first writes is refused, the view shows the refusal, and the page writes it to the application log in its first batch, after the clock requests of the anchor; the host event of a failed write redraws the view with its error, which the page writes to the log; closing the view hides the modal view.
reason: The case shows, updates, places and hides a modal view of a window through the overlay calls and sends the host event of a save, which the Go producer does not run (packages/host/go/tests/page_wire_test.go answers only log and workspace).
